# Repositories that are pinned on a release branch and tagged alongside a tapstate release.
#
# Read twice per release, by two different workflows: once to create the release branch in each, and
# once -- after tapstate's own release is published -- to tag that branch. Keeping the list here
# rather than in either workflow is what stops the two from disagreeing; a repository present in one
# reader and absent from the other gets a branch and never gets a tag, and nothing reports it.
#
# `docs` is deliberately NOT here, and its absence is a decision rather than an oversight. That site
# is built by Netlify from two branches -- `next` is the preview, `main` is what is published -- so a
# third branch cut across them would either publish nothing or publish the wrong thing. Documentation
# is coordinated through an issue instead, by .github/scripts/docs-release.sh, and it never blocks a
# release: see that script for what happens when it is not finished in time.
#
# A satellite release carries no notes of its own. Its body links to the tapstate release, which is
# where what changed is written.
#
# One owner/repo per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. An empty list is refused rather
# than treated as "there are none".

tapstate/tapstate-skills
tapstate/tapstate-web
